protocol.reward: new achievement +1; death -1; inherent 3000-action deadline has zero future value
protocol.comparison: Fresh 16M-ending schedules for all 30 runs; final validation means primary; 4M checkpoints secondary. Paired RNG seeds, not identical rollout data.
protocol.v5_changes: Object footprints, corresponding placement/interaction/light/worldgen/UI corrections only. No recipe/resource/tool/observation changes.
protocol.selection: After all runs: method with highest mean final validation score across both versions and all five seeds; tie lower mean death then name. Paired seed with highest average final v4/v5 score within that method; tie lower mean death then seed. Freeze both final policies before testing.
protocol.test_rule: Same new 128 world IDs once PER VERSION for the two frozen paired policies. Separate exclusive claim files; ambiguous/crashed tests never retried. No tuning against tests.

learning_gate.rule: Report five-seed paired 95% Student-t intervals. Non-inferiority supported only if lower score bound >= -1 and upper death-difference bound <= .05 in every package. Otherwise inconclusive or negative, not automatic promotion. Report furnace/anvil rates separately; do not hide regressions behind aggregate score.

protocol.initialization: No policy warm starts; no transfer of v4 weights to v5.
protocol.promotion: None automatic. Main checkout stays v4; versioned preview/experiment artifacts preserved.

completion.authorization: Run the rest of the runs
completion.compute_note: Final 503,316,480 is retained full-trial transitions, not total physical compute: the interrupted old trials also consumed at least 12,582,912 checkpoint-backed transitions, excluded from the final result.
completion.supervisor_change: Only skip/revalidate verified completed trial directories; fresh exclusive run-start guard and failure preservation remain.
